name: Razorpay
shortInfo: A powerful and fast growing payment gateway which supports 100+ Payment Methods
brief: Razorpay is a powerful and fast growing payment gateway which supports 100+ Payment Methods. It empowers your business with all the right tools to accept online payments and provide the best customer experience.
about:
Power your finance, grow your business. Accept payments from customers. Automate payouts to vendors & employees. Never run out of working capital. Supercharge your business with the all‑powerful Payment Gateway.  
  
Learn more about [Razorpay API documentation.](https://razorpay.com/)
